protocolDesc: Pick what the provider actually serves. Importing a SiYuan provider follows its protocol. Stored per device and never synced
providerDesc: Protocol, base URL, API key and headers come from the provider selected in SiYuan; the provider and model are picked once per device. Add one in SiYuan first if the list is empty
baseUrlDesc: Include the version segment your provider documents, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. For Messages, stop at /v1 — the plugin appends /messages itself
apiKeyDesc: Sent as Authorization: Bearer on Chat Completions and Responses, and as x-api-key on Messages. Leave empty if your endpoint needs no key
apiKeyDescInsecure: No SiYuan data repo key was found, so the API key is stored in plain text. Initialize the data repo key under SiYuan Settings → Data repo key to have it encrypted
apiKeyUnreadable: The stored API key could not be decrypted (the data repo key changed), so it has been cleared. Please enter it again
customHeadersDesc: A JSON object, e.g. {"x-opencode-session": "{{vars.SESSION}}"}. A value may reference a SiYuan variable as {{vars.NAME}} or a secret as {{secrets.NAME}}; both are resolved before every request, and a secret is substituted only when its allowed hosts list contains the base URL's host. A header written here overrides the one the plugin sends itself
modelNameDesc: Type a model name, or pick one with Fetch models
modelFollowEmptyEditor: No default model is set for the editor AI in SiYuan
modelFollowEmptyAgent: No default model is set for the agent in SiYuan
importFromSiyuanDesc: Copy the base URL, API key, custom headers and model from a provider already configured in SiYuan. The plugin keeps its own copy afterwards
importUnsupportedHint: This provider speaks {protocol}. The plugin implements Chat Completions, Responses and Anthropic Messages only, so the request format would not match
importEmpty: No AI provider with an API key or an authentication header is configured in SiYuan settings.
reasoningEffortDesc: Sent as reasoning_effort on Chat Completions, reasoning.effort on Responses, and mapped to thinking on Messages, where the lowest level is the required 1024-token budget — so the output limit must be at least 2048. Disabled asks the model not to reason; Default sends nothing and leaves it to the provider. Strict endpoints reject the parameter outright
temperatureDesc: 0 to 2. Lower values make titles more deterministic. Messages accepts 0 to 1 only, and drops the field when thinking is on or the model is a current-generation one
topPDesc: 0 to 1. Leave empty to omit. Messages drops it when thinking is on or the model is a current-generation one
topKDesc: Left empty the field is not sent, which the official OpenAI API requires. The Responses protocol has no such field, Messages takes an integer. Only some providers accept it
maxTokensDesc: Upper bound for one response. Chat Completions sends max_completion_tokens, falling back to max_tokens when rejected; Responses sends max_output_tokens; Messages sends max_tokens, and its thinking budget comes out of it
timeoutDesc: Timeout for each API request. Batches run concurrently, so this is not a budget shared by the whole operation
retriesDesc: Retried only on rate limits, server errors, timeouts and network failures
contentLimitDesc: Upper bound for one note's body. Only the body counts toward it
truncateModeDesc: What to keep when a note's body is longer than the limit above
truncateHeadRatioDesc: Fraction of the budget kept from the beginning, the rest comes from the end (0 to 1)
mediaHandlingDesc: How links, images, embedded audio/video, iframes and plugin custom blocks reach the model
includeTitleDesc: Sends the document title the note already has along with the body and the outline. Turning it off asks the model to judge from the content alone
tocModeDesc: The heading outline is never truncated; it adds context when the body had to be cut short
tocTruncated: Only when the body is truncated
batchSizeDesc: Selecting more notes splits the work into batches of this size
concurrencyDesc: How many batches may be in flight at once. Lower it if your provider rate limits
autoApplyDesc: Disabled reviews every title first; single note only writes back a single note directly; always writes back directly either way
ignoreInjectionDesc: Appends a line to the system prompt telling the model to ignore any text in the notes that tries to interfere with, decide or influence the titles
systemExtraDesc: Appended to the end of the built-in system prompt. That prompt is fixed because it defines the JSON contract the plugin parses
userExtraDesc: Appended to the end of the user prompt, after the notes
showTopBarDesc: Adds a generate button to the top bar
showBreadcrumbDesc: Adds a generate button to the editor breadcrumb bar
showDocTreeMenuDesc: Adds a generate entry to the document tree right-click menu
debugModeDesc: Logs the full conversation JSON and every pipeline step to the console
testConnectionDesc: Sends one request with the parameters exactly as configured here, including the thinking effort, and asks the model to reply "hi". Any reply means the configuration works
testNoConfig: Fill in the base URL and model name first
testNoConfigProvider: Pick a SiYuan provider and a model first
testOk: Connection OK — model replied "{reply}" in {elapsed} ms
actionTopBar: Generate title for the current note
actionBreadcrumb: Generate title for the current note
noProvider: Configure the AI provider in the plugin settings first
noActiveNote: No note is open. Select notes in the document tree and use the right-click menu
dialogHint: Renaming a document cannot be undone with Ctrl+Z. Uncheck anything you do not want to apply.
summaryNotReturned: {count} note(s) got no title from the model: {list}
reasoningStillOn: Disable thinking had no effect: {tokens} reasoning tokens were still spent
reasoningStillOnNoCount: Disable thinking had no effect: the model still returned a reasoning trace
errorNoChoices: The response contained no completion choices
errorEmptyContent: The model returned no text. It may have spent the whole token budget on reasoning — try disabling thinking or raising max output tokens
errorBadJson: Could not parse a JSON object out of the model response. Raw response: {raw}
errorNotFound: The model returned no title for this note
